scope: Linear ownership and documented semantics only; no admission or business outcome evidence

issue.title: GTM: measure useful outcomes, retained paid conversion and full acquisition cost

selectedEvidence: Keep delivery, reply, claim-view, signup, first useful result, payment and retained/repeated value separate.
A provider enrollment/export, claim click, onboarding-completed flag, positive model grade, trial or subscription ID alone cannot establish delivered contact, useful value or paid conversion.

Receipt-schema and deterministic fixture preparation can proceed through ordinary admission. The existing human checkpoint still governs actual first-value/retained-value semantics and live cohort measurement.
Do not create another analytics, CRM, event-bus or financial ledger system.
interpretation: Use JOV-5243 alongside JOV-6739 for meaningful activation and denominators. This read does not verify current runtime implementation, approve any historical proposed cohort/price/targets, or grant customer outreach/admission.
